name: Mini Double Head Mist Fan with LED Light & Humidifier | Portable USB Air Cooler for Home Office Travel
description:
Beat the heat with the Mini Double Head Mist Fan—your portable solution for cooling and humidifying. Featuring dual mist spray, oscillating airflow, and 3 adjustable wind speeds, it ensures maximum comfort without drying out the air. Built with soft LED lighting and USB Type-C charging, this lightweight fan is perfect for bedrooms, offices, or travel. Compact, quiet, and effective, it’s designed to keep you cool and refreshed anytime, anywhere.
Key Features
 Dual mist spray with cooling & humidification
 3 adjustable wind speeds for custom comfort
 Left-right oscillation for wide coverage airflow
 Built-in LED light for night or ambiance use
 USB Type-C rechargeable & portable design
 Quiet operation—ideal for home, office & travel
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, electronic motor, mist nozzles, LED components
How to Use
 Fill water tank and close lid securely
 Turn on fan and select wind speed
 Activate mist spray for humidification
 Adjust oscillation and LED light as desired
Package Includes
 1 × Mini Double Head Mist Fan
 1 × USB Type-C Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
